ev.q: This report describes two cases of febrile respiratory illness caused by swine-origin influenza A (H3N2) viruses
The girl has completely recovered from this illness.
This report describes two cases of febrile respiratory illness caused by swine-origin influenza A (H3N2) viruses identified on August 19 and August 26, 2011

methods_quotes.q: based on a review of influenza genomic sequences publicly available in GenBank
